title: Iminodiacetic acid stabilized 3d-4f clusters: Synthesis, structure, and magnetism
claim: Heart-shaped IDA-family units made from carbonate-centered [Ln5(μ5-CO3)]13+ and cubane-like [Ln3M(μ3-OH)4] assemble into a Gd44Co28 crown and a larger Gd95Co60 cage.
explanation: The crown is described as approximately C4v, about 1.6 nm high, with square windows near 2.2×2.2 nm and 1.2×1.2 nm. The cage is noncentrosymmetric, with an internal square tunnel of about 1.2 nm, an external size of about 3.4 nm, and a height of about 3.0-3.6 nm, as assigned by single-crystal diffraction.
scope: Carbonate- and hydroxide-bridged Gd-Co clusters stabilized in the IDA system.
conditions: Level-by-level assembly of the heart-shaped motif as proposed in Fig. 6.
caveats: A further series from the same group is stated to be unpublished and in preparation, so only the reported crown and cage should be treated as established examples.
